senses.gloss:
कित् I. €1 P. (केतति)
—1 To desire.
—2 To live.
—3 (चिकित्सति) To heal, cure.
—4 To doubt, suspect. ━II. €3 P. Ved. (चिकेत्ति^1) To know.
[1] Correction submitted by Scott Rhodes on 202605. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/226.

कितवः (-वी f.)
—1 A rogue, liar, cheat; अर्हति किल कितव उपद्रवम् M. 4; Amaru. 20, 46;
 Me. 113.
—2 The Dhattūra plant.
—3 A kind of perfume (commonly रोचन).
—4 A gamester, gambler; Ms. 3. 159.
—5 A mad or crazy person.
